title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Calculation of Entitlement Restored on a Liquidated Loan
content:
Entitlement on a VA Home Loan Guaranty loan liquidated by foreclosure, compromise sale or deed in lieu is restored on the veteran's own request, figured from the entitlement still charged to that loan. Entitlement on a liquidated loan is restored on request while its guaranty debt is still being repaid, and only the entitlement held back stays in use until that debt is repaid.

## The amount restored

The entitlement restored on a liquidated loan is the entitlement charged to the loan less the entitlement already restored from it, less the entitlement held back, never less than zero, rounded to the cent; the entitlement held back is the guaranty loss VA has not recovered on the loan, which is the balance of the home loan guaranty debt that arose from the loan.

## Quantities and where they are read

| Quantity | Meaning | Record |
|---|---|---|
| Entitlement charged | Sum of the entitlement charge entries on the loan | The loan's entitlement history |
| Entitlement already restored | Sum of the restoration entries on the loan | The loan's entitlement history |
| Unrecovered loss | The current balance of the Home Loan Guaranty Debt that arose from the loan; nil where there is none | The veteran's Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery records |
| Entitlement held back | The unrecovered loss times the hold-back share, times one minus the seasoning relief percentage divided by one hundred, times one minus the liquidation relief percentage divided by one hundred, rounded to the cent once at the end | — |

In this calculation the hold-back share is the whole (1), the seasoning relief percentage is 0 and the liquidation relief percentage is 0, so the entitlement held back equals the unrecovered loss. The subtraction of the amount held back comes after the entitlement already restored is taken off the entitlement charged; the result is floored at zero and then rounded to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical loans)

| Line | Loan 1 | Loan 2 |
|---|---|---|
| Entitlement charged | 60,000.00 | 60,000.00 |
| Entitlement already restored | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Balance of the debt from the loan (unrecovered loss) | 18,500.40 | 70,000.00 |
| Entitlement held back | 18,500.40 | 70,000.00 |
| Charged less restored less held back | 41,499.60 | minus 10,000.00 |
| Entitlement restored (never less than zero) | 41,499.60 | 0.00 |

On Loan 1 the 18,500.40 dollars held back stays in use until the debt is repaid; the 41,499.60 dollars restored is available for a future VA loan.
